description:
A lightweight, developer-focused database management tool. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite. Hackable with plugins. Built for speed, security, and aesthetics.


See the assets below to download this version and install.
🐳 Self-host in the browser: docker run -d -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -v tabularis-data:/data ghcr.io/tabularisdb/tabularis:0.33.1 (see the container guide).
What's Changed
- fix(themes): precompile validators for the desktop CSP by @NewtTheWolf in #1627
- fix(plugins): let inline plugin frames grow with their content by @debba in #1628
- fix(plugins): keep Install busy until the plugin lists are reloaded by @debba in #1629
- fix(plugins): drop a removed plugin from Installed right away by @debba in #1630
- fix(sidebar): stop highlighting Connections inside an open connection by @debba in #1632
- fix(mysql): cast CONNECTION_ID() to unsigned for MySQL 5.5 by @antoinelgd in #1603
- fix(docker): build the container image on the 0.33.1 release branch by @debba in #1634
New Contributors
- @antoinelgd made their first contribution in #1603
Full Changelog: v0.33.0...v0.33.1
